question: Identify the top 3 French drivers born between 1980 and 1990 who recorded at least one lap time faster than 01:25.000 in any race where they also set a Q3 qualifying time starting with '1:24'. Return their full names and official introduction URLs.

FROM drivers AS d
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'French'
  AND d."XCL_040" BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1990-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lapTimes AS lt
      WHERE lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
        AND lt."XCL_048" < 85000
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM qualifying AS q
            WHERE q."XCL_058" = d."XCL_034"
              AND q."XCL_057" = lt."XCL_043"
              AND q."XCL_064" LIKE '1:24%'
        )
  )
LIMIT 3
